test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Anita starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the south. She then takes a left turn, drives 8 km, turns left and drives 10 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 2 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 4 km. She takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point D. How far(shortest distance) and in which direction is Point D with respect from Point A?

(All turns are 90^circ turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **Anita starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the south. She then takes a left turn, drives 8 km, turns left and drives 10 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 2 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 4 km. She takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9f28f3f9cf1f8b3270895b8e8aefd71df7e2a6f38f824a521a257cc21a3d04f.png] 

Thus, Point D is 6 km towards east with respect to Point A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
